notes: Read SKILL.md (298 lines) in full. The skill guides a defensive prompt-injection assessment of an LLM application (OWASP LLM01:2025, MITRE ATLAS AML.T0051): map the interaction surface, find direct/indirect injection vectors in code, assess categories (goal hijacking, prompt leaking, privilege escalation, exfiltration, jailbreaking), evaluate defenses and write a report.

It is a code/architecture review with Read/Grep/Glob only; it contains no attack payloads beyond the generic phrase 'ignore previous instructions' as an example to detect, and stresses authorized testing of the user's own systems (SKILL.md:42-48). No commands, installs, credentials, network access, or file writes.
